issue_text: I’m Elena Brooks. Before we change anything, can you tell me the car rental cancellation policy in general for my Las Vegas trip? I want to know whether I’d be charged anything if I cancel the rental.
summary: A short, clean travel-cancellation run for Elena Brooks' Las Vegas trip. The arc is policy→confirm→preview→cancel, done twice: car rental CR-68B7 (T1 policy + lookup, T2 confirm details, T3 preview terms, T4 cancel) then hotel HR-68D9 (T5 policy + recall, T6 preview, T7 cancel), with a reservations recap (T8) and summary (T9). The agent consistently applies the time-based cancellation rules (>24h free for the car, >48h free for the hotel), and the two probe turns are both clean recalls: T5 restates the first booking's rental company (Enterprise) and airport (Las Vegas McCarran) while answering the new hotel-policy question, and T6 reuses HR-68D9's details to produce the exact $0-fee/$298-refund preview. All 8/8 subgoals credit — the tightly-scripted, parameter-pinned user turns leave little ambiguity. Quality is high and the run never re-fetches to answer a back-reference.
